quote: I do not care what case you put; let them be sea-captains, if you will.
source: Margaret Fuller, Woman in the Nineteenth Century, and Kindred Papers, ed. Arthur B. Fuller (1855), p. 174

reason: The page claim holds: the passage opens on p. 174 of the Arthur B. Fuller edition, two sentences after the running head. Wording and the semicolon match, and the preceding sentence, I reply any, is left out without changing the sense. Fuller is unshipped and at none of three.
